text: With live wind blowing and no input, the drone holds still: under 1 m of drift in 15 s.
Cruise passes 60 m/s, boost 150 m/s, and holding boost goes supersonic (343 m/s) within 5 s, with wider FOV, a Mach readout, a vapor cone and a sonic boom; fast flight cannot tunnel through walls.
A warp event plays a light-speed effect and lands the drone safely above the target within 3 s.
The chase camera keeps line of sight to the drone: near buildings it pulls in instead of entering them or jumping onto a roof.
